scripts.build: bun run bin/clean.ts && bun build src/main.ts src/platform/jobs-worker.ts src/platform/guard-worker.ts --target bun --outdir dist --splitting --sourcemap=none --entry-naming [name].[ext]
scripts.build:exe: bun run build && bun build --compile src/main.ts --outfile dist/boite-core.exe
scripts.build:linux: bun run build && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 src/main.ts --outfile dist/boite-core-linux-x64
